title: (RS) is stable under 2-fibre products
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Unwinds the 2-fibre product definition to the equation-level statement; given the datum ((x_Y, z_Y, phi_Y), (x_{X'}, z_{X'}, phi_{X'}), (alpha, beta)), uses (RS) of X and Z to lift (x_Y, x_{X'}, alpha) to x_{Y'} and (z_Y, z_{X'}, beta) to z_{Y'}, reads (phi_Y, phi_{X'}) as a morphism psi in Y_{Y'} between their images, and produces (x_{Y'}, z_{Y'}, psi) as the preimage object; essential surjectivity follows, with full faithfulness omitted as mechanical.
